titulo_ja: けいご の きほん

もうします.en: to be called; to say (humble form)

bloques.titulo: The honorific raises the interlocutor or the person who does the action; the humble reduces his own action before that person.
texto: Common forms: The selection depends on who acts and who is spoken to; it is not added to any verb without taking into account the context.
The Director said he will travel for work next week.)

frases.ja: しゃちょう は、 らいしゅう しゅっちょう すると おっしゃいました。
frases.es: El director dijo que viajará por trabajo la semana que viene.
frases.en: The director said he's going to travel for work next week.

frases.ja: わたし は たなか と もうします。 ごご、 せんせい の ところ へ うかがいます。
frases.es: Me llamo Tanaka. Esta tarde iré a visitar al profesor.
frases.en: My name is Tanaka. I'm going to visit the teacher this afternoon.

bloques.pregunta: What does «おっしゃいました» express in these examples?
